request: MAG-36 — Battery start calculated. When editing a supercharger record on /supercharger-stats, calculate the start battery percentage (when the user does not input it and the end battery is not empty). Inputs: energy added, end battery (user-edited, may be null — skip when null), and the same 62 kWh capacity from packCapacityKWh. The inverse of the formula already in capacity.go for manual charging.

decisions.decision: Store the derived start pct in start_battery_pct and reuse battery_pct_source = 'user_verified'; no migration, no new CHECK value
decisions.why: User chose this over adding 'estimated', shown the cost and the MAG-18 risk that derived rows become indistinguishable from typed ones

decisions.decision: Derive whenever the submitted start is nil and end is non-nil; a submitted start is never overwritten
decisions.why: User chose this over first-time-only and over recalculating when end changes, which could destroy a hand-typed reading

decisions.decision: An out-of-range result stores NULL; the save still succeeds, with no error and no clamping
decisions.why: Mirrors derivedEnergyKWh's return-nil precedent and avoids i18n keys in gateway, keeping this a single-module change

decisions.decision: Offline unit tests only; no new DATABASE_URL-gated integration test for the derivation

decisions.why: Precedent was unambiguous in derivedEnergyKWh, so asking would have spent a round trip on a settled convention
